make.title: Make
make.description: Vehicle manufacturer, e.g. "Honda", "Ford", "Toyota". Matches NHTSA's make spelling; not case-sensitive.

model.title: Model
model.description: Vehicle model, e.g. "Accord", "Explorer", "Camry". Matches NHTSA's model spelling; not case-sensitive.

yearTo.title: Model year to
yearTo.description: Latest model year to search (inclusive). Must be within 15 years of "Model year from" — NHTSA charges one API call per model year searched.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of recalls to return, most recent first.
